'''Kyopulo''' or '''kyopolou''' is a type of Bulgarian relish or spread, made of eggplant, peppers, and tomatoes.

== Ingredients ==
* 2–3 [[Cookbook:Eggplant|aubergines]]
* 4–5 [[Cookbook:Bell Pepper|bell peppers]]
* 2–3 [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]], [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]] or grated
* 3–4 cloves [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]], crushed
* [[Cookbook:Sunflower Oil|Sunflower oil]]
* [[Cookbook:Vinegar|Vinegar]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* [[Cookbook:Parsley|Parsley]], finely [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]

== Procedure ==
# [[Cookbook:Roasting|Roast]] the aubergines and peppers on a hot plate. Remove the skins, and cut into small pieces.
# Add the tomatoes, then the crushed garlic.
# Mix with a wooden spoon, then add oil, vinegar, and salt to taste. Beat together well.
# Pour into a plate and top with finely chopped parsley.
